t: Grinding, Polishing & Aligning Abstraction Focusing Lenses for LLM AIs
s: This article details the development of Pipulate, a local-first web framework, focusing on architectural elegance and AI collaboration. It emphasizes reducing surface area and aligning components to create a more potent partnership with LLMs through iterative refinement and specific methodologies.
